info.title: FarmTrack API
info.description: Voice-guided farmer advisory backend. Contract for the mobile app.

get.description: Liveness plus a database ping. 503 with db=false when the database cannot be reached.

post.description:
Log in with username and password (the username is not case-sensitive).

Returns the tokens and the farmer, like the OTP login. A wrong username and a wrong password give the same 401
`invalid_credentials`; too many tries give 429 `rate_limited` with a Retry-After header.

Send a one-time code by SMS (dev: fixed code, returned as dev_otp when env != prod). Switched off (404) unless OTP_LOGIN_ENABLED.

The answer is the same for a registered and an unregistered number; only registered numbers receive an SMS.
Rotate the refresh token: the old one stops working, a new pair is returned.
Revoke the refresh token (always 204). The short-lived access token simply runs out.

Pipeline: photo quality, crop identification, disease, rules, advice, spoken audio.
Always returns 200 with a status; 'not sure' is a status, never a raw error.

Idempotent: send an `Idempotency-Key` header (a fresh UUID per queued upload, kept on every retry). A replay by the same
farmer returns the stored scan (same ids, 200, header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`) without analysing the photos again.

Offline queue: send `taken_at` (when the photo was taken) and `offline=true`. Advice is always worked out when the server
receives the photo (spray timing and weather are about now), the result carries both times. If the response was lost, the
app can fetch the result with `GET /v1/scans/by-request/{key}` without sending the photos again.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Optional. A random string (a UUID is ideal, 8 to 80 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -) that identifies this one action. Send the same key when the app retries after a lost response or from its offline queue: the server then returns the original result (same ids, 200, header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`) and never creates a second record, repeats the analysis or writes to Zoho twice. Keys are scoped to the logged-in farmer. A key identifies the first request only: reusing it for different content returns the first result.

post.description: 'Add more photos' step: re-evaluates the scan with all photos.
Farmer ticks or corrects the detected crop; the pipeline continues with that crop.

get.description:
The stored result of the scan this farmer uploaded with this Idempotency-Key (404 `scan_not_found`: it never arrived).

For the offline queue: the upload reached the server but the response was lost, so the app does not know the scan id.
Asking here is free (no photos, no analysis); sending the same upload again returns the same scan too.
The stored result, exactly as it was returned when the scan was evaluated.

post.description:
The 'Sprayed' tick. Writes to the DB and to Zoho (adapter). Returns warnings, e.g. a nutrient logged the same day (HP 2026 point 7).

Which medicine: `product_id` (one of the advice's products, or any product of the approved catalogue); else, when only
`advice_id` is sent (the plain 'I sprayed this' tick), the advice's first product, the one that was read aloud; else the
typed `free_text`, which is matched exactly (brand, active ingredient in English or Hindi, or product id) against the
catalogue so the spray checks run. A name that cannot be matched, or that fits several different products, is saved as
typed with the yellow warning `PRODUCT_NOT_RECOGNISED`. An advice without products (the expert route) needs a typed name
(422 `spray_needs_product` otherwise). The advice must belong to the logged-in farmer (404 `advice_not_found`).

Idempotent: send an `Idempotency-Key` header (a fresh UUID per queued entry, kept on every retry). A replay by the same
farmer returns the stored entry (same id, 200, header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`) and writes nothing to Zoho again.

post.description: Register or update the push token for this device. A token seen before moves to the farmer now logged in on it.
Q&A over approved notes only (RAG). refused=true when nothing approved supports an answer.

'Ask a farm expert': stores the request and, when it is about a scan, puts that scan in the agronomist queue.
A request without a scan (a plain question) is listed for the staff in the admin 'Expert requests' page.

get.description:
All fixed voice prompts for a language (voice/prompts.json) with audio refs when generated. Public (no auth).

The version doubles as an ETag, so an app that already has this version gets 304 and downloads nothing.

The whole fixed-prompt audio of one language as one zip (manifest.json + <prompt id>.mp3), for a single download.

Same version as GET /v1/voice/catalogue (also the ETag: 304 when the app is current). 404 `voice_package_empty` while no
audio has been generated yet (the app then uses the phone's own voice). Public, like the catalogue.

304.description: The app already has this version

get.description: Serve cached audio by content-hash name (e.g. ab12...mp3). Public, immutable, cacheable.
Serve the generated audio of a fixed voice prompt (the urls in GET /v1/voice/catalogue). Public.

photos.title: Photos
photos.description: 1 to 4 JPEG/PNG photos of the same crop

client_crop.title: Client Crop
client_crop.description: Crop guessed by the on-device model, if any

taken_at.title: Taken At
taken_at.description: ISO-8601 time the phone took the photo (offline uploads: send it)

offline.title: Offline
offline.description: true when this upload waited in the app's offline queue

ExpertRequestAdminOut.title: ExpertRequestAdminOut
ExpertRequestAdminOut.description: A farmer's 'ask a farm expert' request. With a scan it is also a review task; without one this is the only place staff see it.

crop_id.title: Crop Id
crop_id.description: Crop the question is about (optional; shown to the staff)

note.title: Note
note.description: What was done or told to the farmer (staff record only)

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Contact number, e.g. +919876543210 (a bare 10-digit number is read as Indian)

FarmerCreateIn.title: FarmerCreateIn
FarmerCreateIn.description: The smallest useful farmer record. The phone is required: the database needs it (unique) and the experts call it.

FarmerLoginIn.title: FarmerLoginIn
FarmerLoginIn.description: Set (or reset) the login of a farmer. The username is stored in lower case; the password only as a hash.

LoginIn.title: LoginIn
LoginIn.description:
Username + password login (the MVP login). The username is case-insensitive; the answer for an unknown user and for a wrong
password is the same 401 `invalid_credentials`.

advice_id.title: Advice Id
advice_id.description: The farmer's own advice; with nothing else the advice's first product is logged

product_id.title: Product Id
product_id.description: A product of that advice or of the approved catalogue (422 unknown_product otherwise)

free_text.title: Free Text
free_text.description: Typed medicine name; matched exactly against brands, active ingredients (English or Hindi) and ids
